name: Watashi Suzume
source:
Watashi Suzume is a semi-linear visual novel that follows the exploits of Ayumi Suzume, and her friends after her untimely death and passing. Together, Ayumi must work with her friends in not only solving the mystery behind her own death, but to also help them solve their own personal personal, private issues, should they arise. With a colorful cast of characters, WS aims to tell a story about how important the friendships we form in life are, and how far we would go to help out the ones we love.
